flow.drop_sample_selection: First example per observed drop layer, then chronological rows to sample cap.

smoothed_rtt.qualification: Smoothed sender RTT held between trace changes; excludes initial unknown/zero SRTT; not raw packet RTT or isolated queueing delay.

drop_coverage.absence_of_drop_inference: listed hooks connected with matching IPv4/TcDrop node coverage
drop_coverage.qualification: Manifest coverage is not an independent audit of every loss path.

limitations: Path-truth propagation RTT includes both directions; RTT decreases alone do not prove forward-path overtaking.
Repeated cumulative ACKs are observations, not an independent reconstruction of every duplicate-ACK predicate.
Exact tx_id tags, not packet UIDs, identify transmission instances; joins are retained for a bounded time.
Candidate unnecessary recovery associates a sequence gap, ACK evidence, retransmission and eventual original delivery; controlled comparisons are still needed for a causal performance claim.
LOSS state is reported directly and is not automatically called an RTO without a dedicated timer trace.
Drop trace rows can duplicate one physical loss; distinct tagged transmission counts and per-layer counts are separate.
No observed drop is not proof of no drop when coverage or packet parsing is incomplete.
Traffic-control TcDrop coverage is required before excluding network loss; pre-v3 coverage can omit this path.
Root queue-disc absence must be verified per device or explicitly independently audited; TcDrop does not observe a root queue-disc's own losses.
Receiver TCP window rejection and PAWS/input discards are not covered by queue/IP/device/traffic-control hooks.
Pre-processing wire Rx does not prove acceptance: a gap fill requires subsequent expected_seq advancement or same-time application delivery.
Application HandleRead bytes are ordered unique delivery; wire interval union is a separate metric.
Sequence epochs assume adjacent relevant sequence references differ by less than 2^31 bytes.
Static and dynamic path controls, actual loss tests and deployment-information errors remain separate experimental requirements.
CA_LOSS is not independently identified as an RTO; FCT is reported only when receiver delivery equals positive MaxBytes.
High-threshold intervals come from actual setters; requested window ends alone do not prove restoration.
Source/binary hashes in the copied execution manifest are declarations, not independently rebuilt validation.

tail_policy.qualification: Only observed admissions are dynamically validated; untriggered zero-window, extra-tail-loss, ECN and RTO branches are not empirical safety proofs.

equality.historical_measurement_equality: Only the OFF control is tested against frozen current-tail measurements by compare.py.

caveats: Device-stop, BQL-stop, literal-full occupancy and Queue drop callbacks are distinct.
TC rejection before enqueue can occur with zero Queue::DropBeforeEnqueue callbacks.
Sojourn is per served queue visit; it is not an end-to-end waiting-time sum.
Focus start/end rows hold the preceding state and do not add simulator events.
Natural pairs alone do not isolate routing causality.
Pacing is an active native setting; only OFF has historical trajectory equality.

exact_state_area.method: Integrate previous held packet/byte state at every callback and at final cutoff; no late-flush snapshots.

wire_overhead_focus_visit_check.qualified_scope: Full-payload flow0 enqueue visits inside the fixed focus window.

pacing_analysis.analysis_phase: Postprocessing; completed raw success status is unchanged.
